name: DotCurio
tagline: Curated directory for AI and creative products - discover, compare, and submit

pricing.basis: free submission; optional one-time promotion packages
pricing.native: Free; Fast Pass 29.9 USD, Featured 39.9 USD, Spotlight 49.9 USD (one-time)
pricing.notes: Free tier: review within 1-2 months, no guarantee of indexing. Paid packages publish directly with dofollow links and better placement.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: Review within 1-2 months; no guarantee of indexing.

tiers.name: Fast Pass
tiers.limits: One-time 29.9 USD; no review required, 3+ dofollow links, better discovery placement.

tiers.name: Featured
tiers.limits: One-time 39.9 USD; no review required, 4+ dofollow links, Featured Apps placement.

tiers.name: Spotlight
tiers.limits: One-time 49.9 USD; 5+ dofollow links, Featured Apps placement, top bar spotlight for 7 days.

pricing.freeTierCaps: Review within 1-2 months; indexing not guaranteed

verdictSummary: A prompt can list AI tools on demand, but it will not keep a categorized index fresh, accept product submissions, or maintain editorial comparisons across products. As a single-player lookup the directory is replaceable; as an up-to-date, curated, submission-driven index it is not a one-shot build.
coreLoopDIY: Prompt an LLM for a categorized list of AI and creative products and render the result as a static directory page.
requirements: static hosting for the directory page
whatYouLose: a maintained, categorized index that stays current
a product submission pipeline with review and promotion tiers
cross-product comparisons and rankings kept in one place
moatNotes: the moat is curation and upkeep; the dataset itself is rebuildable by crawling
notes: Directory/aggregator: value is curation and freshness rather than a single-player workflow.
prompt: Build me a curated directory of AI and creative products with categories, product pages, alternatives, and a submission form.
